name: g_CpuMmxDetected
source: Cpu_HasMmx's guard (byte; read 0x5156b1, written 0x5156cf): set, the flag 0x6cfdc4 and the signature 0x6cfdc0 are kept

name: s_DisplayIsRgb565
source: "Display is RGB 565": Zax.CFG's 16-bit pixel format, read (default: the enumerated mode's green mask is 0x7e0) and written back only by ScreenFrame_SetMode 0x567f20 (0x568462, 0x56847d) into the screen frame's +0xcc (0: 5-5-5); [Reimpl] Force555=1 answers 0 (reimpl/src/sim_hw.cpp)
